value.rationale: The generalization varies the natural prey intrinsic-growth factor of a concrete ecological discretization, and detects a sharp universal threshold separating all-parameter exclusion from constructible positive coexistence cycles. The exact entire cycle parameterization shows that the threshold is not an artifact of an example, and identifies the complete admissible shape of cycles regardless of predator conversion/mortality choices. This separates absence of period doubling from other invariant-circle dynamics; no claim to a global orbit classification is made.
